artifact_policy.retention_note: GitHub Actions artifacts are not permanent archival storage; copy raw outputs to durable storage before expiry

H1_ledger_binding.action_pair: both modeled-belief rows correct and selected semantic action switches
H1_ledger_binding.actual_belief_control: selected action invariant across actual-belief nuisance rows
H1_ledger_binding.report: report accuracy by named ledger target

H2_policy_composition.action_pair: literal and contrarian rows both correct and selected semantic action switches

H3_evidence_independence.raw_contrast: selected-label change rate, descriptive only and never a support gate
H3_evidence_independence.report_pair: independent and copied rows both correct and selected semantic label switches in each prompt mode

H5_active_information.cost_threshold: same matrix, low-cost versus high-cost choices both correct and switch
H5_active_information.reliability_threshold: same matrix, perfect versus noisy choices both correct and switch
H5_active_information.voi_pair: positive and negative VOI rows both correct and inspect/act choice switches

execution.remote_compute_policy: CPU controls locally; Qwen3.8 tokenizer preflight and model stages only through manual GitHub Actions; no automatic stage chaining

statistics.missing_or_unparseable: retain raw text and score as failure
statistics.paired_test_policy: For direct-versus-thinking comparisons, match the same endpoint cells by condition identity, aggregate differences by game_id, and run the sign-flip test only when the endpoint's family gate is eligible in both conditions.

subset.diagnostic_selection_rule: All locked ledger rows; all locked policy-composition rows; all locked evidence report rows with evidence_count=4, evidence_direction=prior, an independent/copy expected-value contrast, and both prompt modes; all locked active-information rows in positive/negative VOI matched groups and same-matrix threshold groups. The rule is evaluated before any Qwen3.8 output exists.
subset.pilot_selection_rule: The first validation ledger game in condition_id order; the first validation policy game; the first identifying evidence pair in each prompt mode; the first positive/negative VOI pair; and the first complete same-matrix threshold cell. The pilot is non-confirmatory and never selects locked rows.
